name: אַדְרַמֶּלֶךְ
summary: Adrammelech and Sharezer strike down their father Sennacherib in the temple of Nisroch. Isaiah recounts the same event. The same spelling also names a deity worshipped by the Sepharvites.
note: The final element resembles king. The first element and the historical relationship between the Assyrian personal name and the deity’s name are uncertain.
